candidate_families: P3 root plus verified follow-up allowances: naive and capped variants
P5 prepaid transport or logical reservations

hard_constraints.cancel: spent attempts never refunded; root cannot mint authorization when it fails or is unadmitted
hard_constraints.concurrency: unchanged2 global/1 ClientIP; no priorities or exemptions
hard_constraints.denial: no RF handler work on budget/authorization denial
hard_constraints.deployment: one current Compose app/process; no distributed infrastructure now
hard_constraints.increment_rule: allow only the mathematically necessary eight additional RF admissions and only server-verified deterministic follow-ups; no unconditional endpoint exemption
hard_constraints.ordinary_baseline_sequences: retain all ≤20 ordinary calls in a fresh bucket without pre-existing reservations; pending accepted obligations can temporarily reduce availability and require bounded cleanup
hard_constraints.science: RF inputs, bodies, equations, search, Pareto, fingerprints and persistence unchanged
hard_constraints.state: bounded process-local ephemeral only; no RF bodies/results in authorization records

interpretation: Maintaining every arbitrary RF-call ceiling at20 while permitting a28-call legitimate chain is impossible. The normative tolerance is an exact+8 execution envelope confined to verified dependencies, with legacy independent ceilings preserved. This is a security/product judgment requiring future validation, not a measured security-equivalence claim.

L1.guarantee: fresh retained ClientIP bucket: one normal action; if a root is budget-admitted, reserve its mandatory follow-ups so another action cannot cause a mid-queue budget denial
L1.scope: budget guarantee only; concurrency, validation, cancellation, deadline, response failure and finite lease still apply

L2.guarantee: fresh retained ClientIP bucket: the following bounded normal analysis chains complete without budget429

L3.beyond_scope: another inspection/analysis after L3, repeated L3, or two simultaneous users each demanding L3 may wait for reset; no indefinite action-chain guarantee
L3.guarantee: one full evaluation cycle → Optimize/maps in the same window from a fresh retained bucket
L3.product_decision: REQUIRED uninterrupted; the existing comparison/optimization UI is a continuation of analysis, and a successful Optimize response without its required maps is not committed as a completed result. This is a stated design recommendation, not an assertion of a user promise.

selection_method: hard constraints first, then explicit minimality/tradeoffs; no composite score
simulation: closed-form/offline journey ledgers and boundary bounds only; no running policy enforcement, tokens, request server or RF engines
study: design only; no new limiter or RF measurements
timing_evidence: reuse clean successor B; no new RF qualification
